content:
My FLT course is over for now (it will start again in a month) and amongst the things I'm doing over the next few weeks is merging some PRs and bumping the repo to 4.29. Yesterday I merged FLT#858 , a PR which was passing CI, but now FLT has a red X with the error in the compiling blueprint stage. The error is

and a link to this is here. I don't even know what Ruby is but the issue is clear:

connection_pool-3.0.2 requires ruby version >= 3.2.0, which is incompatible with
the current version, 3.1.7

Does anyone know how to fix it?
Very weird; I don't see any changes that would have caused this. Maybe try re-running the job and seeing if it goes away?
I believe the ruby version in leanprover-community/docgen-action/main/scripts/build_docs.sh needs updating
(thanks to @Yan Yablonovskiy 🇺🇦 for debugging this yesterday in GibbsMeasure)
I didn't see a version reference in build_docs.sh, so I opened docgen-action#27 which updates ruby-version in the action.yml.

Ah, I guess the direct culprit was probably the dependabot PR FLT#874 which adds connection_pool (3.0.2).

Hmm, I don't know enough about how ruby is used in downstream projects to know whether changing the ruby version in docgen-action is a wise idea or not.
Maybe the quickest fix for Kevin is just to revert FLT#874 for now?

Bryan Gin-ge Chen said:

Ah, I guess the direct culprit was probably the dependabot PR FLT#874 which adds connection_pool (3.0.2).

I am merging these dependabot PRs without thinking. Should thought be involved? I'll try reverting it -- thanks to everyone for the help as ever! FLT#879

Kevin Buzzard said:

Should thought be involved?

Ideally no, but I'm not sure what the best solution is here yet. I don't know enough about ruby here but I wonder if docgen-action should instead not enforce a ruby version and instead downstream projects should specify their requirements with ".ruby-version, .tool-versions or mise.toml", per the ruby/setup-ruby action?
CI is green after the revert -- many thanks!
